Before I make my final decision, I'd like to follow our routine process and check with the relevant teams. Could I hear from infectious disease, utilization review, and specialty-pharmacy coordination on the clinical, coverage, and delivery details for both the formulary option of daily IV ceftriaxone and the restricted nonformulary oral linezolid? The patient has expressed a preference for an oral option if one can be arranged appropriately.
